justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/body/ConstructorDeclaration.java` (315 lines, 24 public constructors/methods) plus its bases `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/body/CallableDeclaration.java` and `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/body/BodyDeclaration.java`. `ConstructorDeclaration` adds only one extra field (`body`) and mostly contains constructors, accessors, and generated overrides (`accept`, `clone`, `replace`, type-casting, `resolve`); the broader responsibilities for modifiers, name, parameters, thrown exceptions, type parameters, and annotations live in the superclass chain. This looks like a focused AST specialization rather than a class with clearly separated, under-modularized responsibilities.
